$comment: 字体方向。只用系统字体，不引入字体文件。按所选审美方向选一种。贡献见 CONTRIBUTING.md。

directions.name: 圆润粗体
directions.stack: ui-rounded, -apple-system, "SF Pro Rounded", "PingFang SC", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
directions.use: modern-casual, realistic-clean, cartoon-vector, soft-pastel, paper-cut, low-poly-3d

directions.name: 像素等宽
directions.stack: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "PingFang SC", monospace

directions.name: 衬线书卷
directions.stack: "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

hierarchy: 任何方向都要有三级：标题/分数 > 按钮/强调 > 正文。分数和计时永远最大最粗，数字等宽 (tabular-nums)。正文不小于 16px——这是可读性底线，不是审美规则。
fallbacks: Android 没有 ui-rounded 和楷体，会退到系统无衬线；关键信息不要依赖特定字体形状
